content_sections.heading: MP Police Subedar Steno ASI Vacancy 2026
Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy all the following requirements: Passed Higher Secondary or 10+2 examination from a recognized board. Passed Hindi shorthand examination at a speed of 100 words per minute from a recognized board, council, polytechnic, ITI or equivalent institution. Possess a valid CPCT certificate with Hindi typing. Possess an approved computer qualification. Candidates must satisfy the following requirements: Passed the 10+2 or Class 12 examination from a recognized board or institution. Possess a valid CPCT certificate with Hindi typing. Possess an approved Degree, Diploma or certificate in computers or information technology.

content_sections.heading: Accepted Computer Qualifications
content_sections.text: Depending on the post, the notification accepts qualifications such as: Engineering Degree in the relevant computer or information technology field MCA BCA M.Sc. in Computer Science or Information Technology AICTE-approved Polytechnic Diploma DOEACC Diploma-level examination One-year Computer Operator and Programming Assistant certificate from a government-recognized ITI Modern Office Management course from a recognized institution Computer Diploma from a UGC-recognized institution or open university Candidates must possess all required qualifications and certificates by 8 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age will be calculated as of 8 October 2026 . Category-based reservation and age relaxation are available only to eligible Madhya Pradesh domicile candidates. Candidates from other states can apply only against unreserved open vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Salary
content_sections.text: According to the applicable Madhya Pradesh Government rules, newly appointed candidates will receive 70% of the minimum pay during the first year, 80% during the second year and 90% during the third year. Applicable allowances will be payable according to government rules.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Rs.60 when the application is submitted through an MP Online kiosk. Rs.20 when submitted through a registered citizen-user login. Correction fee: Rs.20 for each correction attempt. Portal charge for correction: Rs.40.

rows.category: SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates who are Madhya Pradesh domiciles

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The MP Police Subedar Stenographer and ASI selection process includes: First-stage online written examination Shortlisting based on the written examination percentile Document verification Hindi stenography or Hindi typing practical examination Physical measurement verification Medical examination Final merit list Candidates up to seven times the number of advertised vacancies in each vertical category will be shortlisted for the second stage. Candidates obtaining the same percentile as the cutoff will also be called, even if this increases the number beyond seven times the vacancies. The final selection will be based on the combined marks obtained in the written and practical examinations.

content_sections.heading: Subedar Stenographer Practical Test
content_sections.text: The test will include two Hindi shorthand dictations. Each dictation will be given for five minutes at 100 words per minute. Two shorthand dictations of five minutes each Five minutes after each dictation to read and correct the draft Twenty minutes to type the transcription of each dictation Each dictation carries 10 marks Typing the transcription of each dictation carries 40 marks

content_sections.heading: ASI Ministerial Practical Test
content_sections.text: Candidates will be given two Hindi paragraphs containing 600 words each. Each paragraph must be typed within 30 minutes. First Hindi paragraph: 600 words and 30 minutes Second Hindi paragraph: 600 words and 30 minutes Each paragraph carries a maximum of 50 marks Only the content typed on the computer will be evaluated

content_sections.heading: Physical Standards
content_sections.text: No relaxation will be provided in the prescribed physical height standards.

content_sections.heading: Medical Standards
content_sections.text: The candidate must satisfy the prescribed height requirement. Unaided visual acuity must not be below 6/9 in one eye and 6/12 in the other eye. The candidate must be able to distinguish primary colours. The candidate must not have knock knees or flat feet. The candidate must satisfy the medical-fitness requirements prescribed for police service.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MP Police Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official MPESB website at esb.mp.gov.in . Open the online application link for the Subedar Stenographer and ASI Ministerial Selection Examination 2026. Complete Aadhaar verification and candidate-profile registration. Enter personal, educational, domicile, category and employment details. Select the eligible post and cadre preferences. Upload the required photograph, signature and documents. Pay the examination and portal fees. Check all information before final submission. Submit the form by 8 October 2026. Save the application number and print the completed application.

content_sections.heading: Examination Cities
content_sections.text: The online examination is scheduled to be conducted in the following Madhya Pradesh cities: Bhopal Indore Jabalpur Khandwa Neemuch Ratlam Rewa Sagar Satna Sidhi Ujjain Barwani Anuppur

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in MP Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 655 vacancies, including 135 Subedar Stenographer and 520 Assistant Sub-Inspector Ministerial posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 8 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When will the written examination begin?
faq.answer: The first-stage online examination will begin on 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Subedar Stenographer?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12, possess Hindi shorthand speed of 100 words per minute, hold a CPCT certificate with Hindi typing and possess an approved computer qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for ASI Ministerial?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12, possess a CPCT certificate with Hindi typing and hold an approved computer qualification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there negative marking in the written examination?
faq.answer: No. Marks will not be deducted for incorrect or unanswered questions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.500 for unreserved candidates and Rs.250 for eligible SC, ST, OBC and EWS candidates who are Madhya Pradesh domiciles. Portal charges are additional.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an online written examination, document verification, stenography or typing practical test, physical measurement verification and medical examination.
